gettingStarted.title: Get started
gettingStarted.intro: Check your personal customer access, a sample funding bound and an actual first-call receipt. Configuration and funding are snapshots; sending a call remains a separate action.
gettingStarted.unreachable: Could not check this step. The rest of the page still works; reload to try again.

channel.title: Find a permitted model with sale terms
channel.done: A live visible key can reach a configured chat model with your effective customer sale terms.
channel.todo: No priced chat sample was established. Check your key permissions or ask the business operator to configure access and customer sale terms.

credit.title: Check sample funding
credit.done: Current quota and wallet funding cover this sample under the checked constraints.
credit.todo: Funding for this sample is not confirmed. Review the reason below; adding funds only resolves an actual funding shortage.

key.title: Use a live permitted API key
key.done: At least one current, unrevoked key is visible to you.
key.todo: No live key is visible. Create your own key or ask your account administrator to restore access.

request.title: Send a real request
request.done: A successful call has settled with a visible, recomputable receipt, including zero-cost calls.
request.todoNone: No eligible successful call is recorded in your current scope yet.
request.todoRecorded: {{refused}} refused and {{errored}} errored request(s) are recorded, but none settled. Open Requests to see the recorded outcome.
request.note: Calls use the applicable published price and funding. Free or fully entitled calls can settle without a wallet charge.

bill.title: Verify your first call
bill.done: A receipt is available now. Open it to verify its entry and charge in your browser.
bill.todo: Complete a successful call to obtain its immediate receipt.
bill.note: Closed-period reports are available separately after the UTC period ends. They are not required to verify a call today.

boundary.title: What the customer's check establishes
boundary.body: The bill page recomputes the content hash and the inclusion proof in the customer's browser and, where the deployment publishes one, checks the operator's signed head. It proves the rows were not rewritten; it does not prove the upstream returned those token counts. Without OXSUM_HEAD_SIGNING_KEY the page says the head is unsigned, and inclusion still verifies.

gettingStarted.receiptRestricted: Sign in with a personal customer session to check your visible receipts.
gettingStarted.servingRestricted: Your current customer access is restricted. Sign in personally or ask your account administrator about the restriction.

sample.title: Illustrative chat funding check
sample.shape: Model {{model}} · one user message “Hello” · requested maximum output 32 tokens.
sample.note: 1 credit = 1,000,000 credit-minor. The conservative reservation includes flat fees and conditional rates before settlement discounts. No call is sent here. Rate limits, policy execution and provider availability are checked when you actually call.
sample.limited: The search checked at most 8 keys and 16 chat models per key. Other eligible choices may exist; review your keys and model access.

reasons.noLiveKey: Create or restore a live personal key.
reasons.noPermittedChatModel: No configured chat model is permitted for the keys checked. Ask the business operator about model access.
reasons.saleUnavailable: A model is configured, but effective customer sale terms are missing. Ask the business operator to publish or assign terms.
reasons.saleModeMismatch: The configured route and customer sale mode do not agree. Ask the business operator to review this model.
reasons.ledgerUninitialized: This new account has no initialized ledger yet. The preview does not create one. Normal first use initializes it; funding readiness is not confirmed here.
reasons.insufficientFunds: Recorded quota and available wallet pools do not cover the sample reservation. Review funding options.
reasons.quotaExhausted: Recorded quota is exhausted and wallet overflow is disabled. Review your plan or contact the business.
reasons.quotaTransitionRequired: The quota period needs a lifecycle transition. Refresh after processing or ask the business operator to review it.
reasons.promoExpiryPending: A promotion expiry is pending. Refresh after processing before relying on this balance.
reasons.budgetExceeded: A key, member or team budget cannot cover the wallet share. Review limits with your account administrator.
reasons.concurrencyExceeded: The selected key has reached its concurrent-request limit. Retry after active calls finish.
reasons.planCreditExceeded: Plan debt and pending reservations exceed the allowed overage limit. Review Billing.
reasons.restricted: The account or plan currently restricts this call. Contact your account administrator.
reasons.keyInactive: The key is no longer live. Refresh and choose a current key.

topup.noAirwallexRail: This deployment has no Airwallex rail configured.
topup.hyperswitchIntro: Mounts the switch's Unified Checkout in place; the deposit confirms through the Hyperswitch webhook once the payment succeeds. A deployment without the rail configured answers 503.

topup.noHyperswitchRail: This deployment has no Hyperswitch rail configured.

credentials.name: Name
credentials.retired: Legacy service credentials are disabled. Ask the business owner for an integration credential with the required scopes, selected customers and expiry.

deposits.empty: No deposits yet — a top-up, a code redemption or a rail payment appears here.
deposits.statusNote: Statuses are the rails' facts: pending (opened, not paid), confirmed (the rail says paid, the ledger has not credited yet), credited (the entry named on the row moved the wallet), reversed (a refund or chargeback — the Entry cell then names the reversal's own entry) or expired. A received amount appears only when the rail reported a different figure than the deposit was opened for. Reversing posts one ledger entry taking the purchased credit back — and for a rail that moves money back (the Hyperswitch switch) it issues the rail's refund too: the row then shows `refund pending`/`succeeded`/`failed` under the status, `failed` meaning the rail refused the call so a retry re-issues it. `disputed` marks a charge the rail reported contested.
deposits.reverseHint: required, it becomes the reversal entry's description

requests.intro: Every gateway request across every organization — settled, errored or refused — with the model that answered, the channel, the tokens and the charge. The SRE query reads this.

margin.empty: No settled turns yet — a row appears once a gateway turn settles and its upstream cost is recorded.
margin.note: The provider bill is what the upstream billed the channel, summed per day by the upstream-bill-sync pass; “not reconciled” means that pass has not billed the channel yet, not that it billed nothing. The total counts each channel once — the API repeats the channel-scoped figure on every model row. Untracked turns are settled turns with no upstream cost recorded (an untracked price, a swept hold, or history), so a growing gap there is where missing upstream pricing shows up first.

guardrails.preCallBody: The request's texts are judged before the hold. A block refuses 403 and costs nothing.
guardrails.postCallBody: A block refunds the hold in full and still refuses the turn. The upstream answer was already produced.
guardrails.streamedBody: A verdict that lands after streaming starts can only be recorded. The output already sent cannot be retracted.
guardrails.recordedBody: Recorded verdicts include policy, evaluation phase and verdict, plus the complete short reason or a digest of the separately retained full text. Streamed verdicts mark that the answer had already been delivered.
guardrails.failOpen: Deleting a bound policy is allowed: turns skip the dangling name (fail-open) until the binding is updated.
guardrails.deletePolicyNote: Bindings that name it remain, but turns skip a dangling name until the binding is updated.
guardrails.name: Name
guardrails.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens. Saving an existing name replaces that policy.
guardrails.nameLocked: The name is the policy's address; create a new policy to rename it.
guardrails.keywordHint: Each pattern is a regular expression over the request and answer text. Flag records a match; block refuses the turn.
guardrails.piiHint: The built-in scan looks for email addresses, card numbers and similar PII in the answer text. It always flags and never rewrites.
guardrails.endpointHint: An absolute http(s) URL the gateway posts the request or answer texts to.
guardrails.timeoutHint: Optional. The gateway's own default applies when blank.
guardrails.bearerHint: Write-only. Stored sealed on the policy row and never read back.
guardrails.bearerEditHint: Leave blank to keep the stored bearer.
guardrails.endpointInvalid: The endpoint must be an absolute http(s) URL.
guardrails.timeoutInvalid: The timeout must be a whole number of milliseconds greater than zero.
guardrails.bindingsHint: Channel bindings run on every turn the channel leads; key bindings run on every turn of that key. A key's own requiredPolicies adds policies, and a mandate can only narrow them.
guardrails.targetKeyHint: Paste the key's id from the customer's keys page. The admin API has no key list to choose from.
guardrails.channelEmpty: Create a channel before binding one.
guardrails.noPoliciesSelected: No policies selected — this binding runs nothing.
guardrails.deleteBindingNote: The policy set stops applying to that scope on the next turn.

disputes.resolveExplain: Select the actual provider outcome and record the supporting reason. A local decision is not proof of an external payment.

effects.evidenceDue: Keep the dispute open while evidence is required. This decision does not move money.
effects.won: Record that the business won this dispute. This decision does not move money.
effects.lost: Record the confirmed cash loss. Original funding and any resulting customer debt or review amount are accounted for exactly once. This does not initiate a provider refund.
effects.closed: Close the case without recording a cash loss. This decision does not move money.

disputes.frozenResolution: This decision is fixed for safe retry. Retrying keeps the same outcome, reason and operation identity.

statements.title: Statements
statements.graceExplain: Extends this statement's due date. Spending stays suspended if another debt is past grace.
statements.voidExplain: Reverses this statement and its matching journal together. Cash stays unchanged; collected funds become refund payable. Mixed or reissued bills require financial reconciliation.

journals.frozenVoid: This correction is fixed for retry. Its journal, reason and operation identity stay unchanged.
journals.voidExplain: Cancels only this journal’s charges and payments, including its lines on mixed statements. Other sources remain. Cash stays unchanged; collected funds become refund payable. Resolve pending checkouts first.

exceptions.title: Exceptions
exceptions.repairExplain: Runs the audited corrective action {{action}} — a repair row plus finance_audit.
exceptions.resolveExplain: Marks the drift corrected — the resolution is required and audited.
exceptions.waiveExplain: Records that the drift is not a defect — audited like a resolution.

staff.title: Staff
staff.userIdHint: An existing registered user's id; the owner role is set by ownership transfer, not here.
staff.revokeExplain: {{email}} loses business authority at once; personal customer access is retained.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.revokeExplain: The credential stops authenticating at once; the audit keeps the reason.

provider.intro: Provider connections and credentials are managed by the business owner. Saving configuration makes no upstream request.
provider.changeHelp: Save an audited change for {{name}}. Secrets are write-only.
provider.nameHelp: A stable, unique name. Open an existing connection to edit it.
provider.networkHelp: Public connections require HTTPS and public IP addresses. Internal access needs an explicit owner grant.
provider.ipsHelp: Exact IPv4 or IPv6 addresses, separated by lines or commas. Hostnames and CIDR ranges are not accepted. Every resolved address must be approved; reserved and metadata addresses remain blocked.
provider.secretHelp: Enter a fresh secret. Only its last four characters can be read after saving. Drafts stay in memory and are discarded when this dialog closes.
provider.repoint: Changing {{url}} or its protocol replaces the credential pool and clears the billing credential. Supply a fresh key for the new destination. Calls already admitted retain their pinned context.
provider.rotateHelp: To rotate a key, add the new credential, then disable or remove the old one. Credentials are never revealed. Removing the last active credential is refused; disabling it explicitly stops new service.
provider.disableHelp: Disable {{name}}? If no active credential remains, new requests cannot use this connection. Calls already admitted retain their pinned context.
provider.removeHelp: Permanently remove {{name}} from the pool? The last active credential cannot be removed. Add a replacement first, or disable credentials to stop service.
provider.clearHelp: Clear the provider billing credential for {{name}}? Billing queries that require it will stop until a new credential is supplied.
provider.checkHelp: Send one authenticated HEAD request for {{name}} to {{url}}. This generates no model tokens. Redirects and unapproved destinations are refused.
provider.checkLimit: A HEAD result checks reachability only. It does not certify inference, provider billing, or customer sale terms.
provider.checkOnce: This result belongs to one audited attempt. A pending result is not retried automatically. Close this dialog and deliberately start another check only if needed.
provider.retryHelp: The outcome may be unknown. Retry unchanged fields to reuse this operation; editing a field starts a new operation. Draft inputs are preserved here.
provider.costHelp: Base rates are retained channel billing rates used when a customer has no sale terms. Supplier cost belongs in the upstream cost fields. Published customer sale books are managed separately.
provider.saved: Configuration saved. The latest channel data has been requested.
provider.unavailable: This channel is no longer available on the current page. Return to the list and reload.
provider.upsertHelp: This operation sets a connection by its unique name. If that name already exists, its entire credential pool is replaced. An endpoint or protocol change also clears its billing credential. To preserve an existing pool, cancel and edit that connection from the list.

profile.title: Business profile
profile.intro: One public identity for login and customer/staff portals. Only the business owner can save it. Profile changes do not change billing, currency or historical documents.
profile.name: Business name
profile.publicContact: Shown to customers. This does not configure email delivery. Leave blank to clear.
profile.urlHelp: An absolute HTTP(S) URL without embedded credentials. Leave blank to clear.
profile.accentHelp: Optional #rrggbb. Use a dark color with readable white button text; leave blank for the standard palette.
profile.saveHelp: Editing revision {{revision}}. Saving fixes the complete profile in the database, including empty optional fields; future environment changes cannot overwrite it.
profile.retryHelp: Draft preserved. Retry unchanged to recover the same operation. If another editor changed the profile, discard and reload before reviewing a new draft.
profile.saved: Profile saved. Current identity has been requested again; historical documents are unchanged.
profile.defaults: Unsaved defaults: the setup name and deployment branding. Revision {{revision}}.
profile.stored: Owner-managed profile. Revision {{revision}}. Environment branding no longer overrides these values.

staffInv.title: Invite staff by email
staffInv.emailHint: The recipient accepts through their own session on this address; no user ID is needed.
staffInv.revokeExplain: The pending link to {{email}} stops working; nothing the recipient already did is undone.

providerModels.changeHelp: Manage {{channel}} through your business session. Configuration saves make no model request.
providerModels.modeHelp: Chat needs a positive output limit. Other modes need zero; embeddings and rerank also need zero output rate.
providerModels.weightHelp: 1–1000. Relative preference among channels serving the same model. Saving appends a complete model version.
providerModels.priceHelp: Base rates are retained channel billing rates used when a customer has no sale terms. Supplier cost belongs in the upstream cost fields. Published customer sale books are managed separately.
providerModels.appendHelp: Start from {{model}} v{{version}}. Save a complete new version; the current version at save time determines the next number. Existing admitted calls retain their pinned version.

rates.cacheWrite5mPricePerMillion: Cache write (5 min) credits per million
rates.cacheWrite1hPricePerMillion: Cache write (1 hour) credits per million

providerModels.requiredRate: Required. Exact nonnegative credits with up to six fractional digits. Zero is an explicit free rate.
providerModels.optionalRate: Blank retains the documented base-rate fallback; a blank per-request rate adds no flat fee.
providerModels.upstreamHelp: Amounts the supplier charges, in credit units. These are separate from customer prices. Missing cost is untracked; it is not a claim of zero supplier spend.
providerModels.upstreamOptional: Blank leaves this cost dimension unspecified. Zero is an explicit known zero.
providerModels.clearUpstream: Omit supplier cost from new version
providerModels.rulesHelp: Each rule replaces the complete base price and supplier cost. Token bounds are inclusive. Equally specific overlapping rules are refused by the server.
providerModels.aliasHelp: Choose a non-event model already served by this channel. Names must be unique; changing a mapping requires explicitly removing and adding the alias.
providerModels.removeHelp: Remove {{alias}} from {{channel}}? New calls using it may fail. Existing admitted calls retain their pinned route.
providerModels.fallbackHelp: One served model or alias per line, in order, at most 16. No duplicates or self reference. Empty clears the chain. The server verifies business ownership; each request also checks protocol, mode and customer access.
providerModels.cacheHelp: Reuse applies only to eligible whole, non-streamed primary answers with reported usage. Exact request, identity, permissions, route and sale context are bound. System instructions always participate. A hit has no new supplier inference and uses the applicable cache billing rate.
providerModels.foreverHelp: An eligible answer may be reused indefinitely while its complete admitted context still matches.

errors.integer: Enter a whole number in the supported range; route weight is 1–1000 and cache lifetime must be positive.
errors.storedRange: This stored value exceeds the exact range of the browser editor. No edit was opened or silently rounded.
errors.rate: Enter an exact nonnegative rate with at most six fractional digits; input and output rates are required.
errors.flatRate: The per-request amount exceeds the billing engine range.
errors.mode: The selected billing mode conflicts with the output rate or output limit. Review every base and conditional price.
errors.name: Use a nonempty model name of at most 200 characters without control characters.
errors.rules: Use at most 100 conditional prices with a nonempty tier or valid inclusive token bounds.
errors.fallbacks: Use at most 16 distinct fallback names, one per line, excluding the primary model.

merchant.nameHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens.
merchant.identityHelp: Provider account identifier. Identity, rail and mode are immutable after creation.
merchant.createHelp: A new merchant starts disabled. Configure and review it before enabling future checkout.
merchant.localOnly: Local validation checks fields and destination syntax only. Saving does not establish reachability, successful checkout or external PSP certification.
merchant.secretHelp: Write only. Supply the complete credential; stored secrets are never returned.
merchant.sdkHelp: Public HTTPS script URL. Also configure the SDK API backend and allowed browser origin in your Hyperswitch deployment.
merchant.rotationHelp: Append a complete version after v{{revision}}. Checkout enablement is preserved; retained versions continue to verify their pinned callbacks.
merchant.disableHelp: Stop new checkout selection for this merchant. Existing orders and retained callback versions remain valid.
merchant.enableHelp: Allow future selection under the current version. This does not make it the default route or prove that payments work.
merchant.liveHelp: This is a live-mode merchant. Its credentials and subsequent checkout can reach live payment services.
merchant.callbackHelp: Configure this exact URL for this version at the provider. The provider must be able to reach the current site origin. Retain old callback coordinates for in-flight orders.
merchant.noAccess: Your business role cannot read merchant configuration.

checkoutRoutes.title: Checkout selection
checkoutRoutes.saved: Selection saved. Existing orders retain their original merchant version.
checkoutRoutes.help: This explicit selection replaces the current route for new orders only. Disabling never falls back to another merchant. Old orders and callbacks keep their pinned versions.

applicationAccess.applicationHelp: Create a stable namespace for one application. Its retained account limit includes archived accounts. Creation grants no human login, existing customer access or funds.
applicationAccess.frozen: This request is fixed for safe retries. A new operation may create an additional resource if the previous response was lost; first inspect the list and revoke any unwanted credential. Reloading does not submit a request.
applicationAccess.provisionHelp: Creates new business-scoped accounts under this credential. It cannot read, meter or archive them with this grant. Replacement credentials do not share this namespace; prefer an application for new integrations.
applicationAccess.selectFirst: Create or select an application above.
applicationAccess.invalid: Select the application or customers, at least one valid scope, a whole expiry from 1 to 365 days, and a reason.
applicationAccess.copyFailed: Copy failed; select the displayed secret and copy it manually.
applicationAccess.secretUnavailable: Credential {{id}} already exists. Its secret cannot be retrieved after the first response. If you did not retain it, revoke this credential and create a replacement.

scopes.customersRead: Read customer profiles and identity mapping
scopes.customersProvision: Create new customer accounts in this grant’s namespace
scopes.meteringWrite: Reserve and charge declared external work
scopes.billingRead: Read scoped customer balances, logs and bills
scopes.customersLifecycleWrite: Archive application accounts; retain funds and history
scopes.customerKeysWrite: Issue and revoke bounded customer gateway keys
scopes.entitlementsRead: Read application entitlement, permitted models and customer sale terms
scopes.customerLinkWrite: Invite verified personal ownership of application accounts
scopes.checkoutWrite: Initiate and recover application customer checkout

applicationAccess.invalidApplication: Enter a stable key, a name, a reason and an account limit from 1 to 10,000.

notifications.title: Notifications · {{name}}
notifications.help: Send signed lifecycle signals to your application. The receiver must deduplicate delivery IDs and read current scoped state. At most two destinations are active; existing events are not replayed when a destination is created.
notifications.disableHelp: Disabling stops new enqueue and unclaimed sends. An already claimed delivery may finish. Create a replacement endpoint to rotate the address or signing key.
notifications.emptyDeliveries: No signals have been queued for this endpoint.
notifications.secretUnavailable: This operation already created an endpoint. Its signing secret cannot be read again; configure a replacement if the first response was lost.

setup.title: Initialize your business
setup.intro: Accept the deployment invitation to become the business owner. Public registration never grants business ownership.
setup.tokenHint: Paste the token privately supplied by the deployer. It expires after 30 minutes and is kept only on this page.
setup.emailHint: Use the exact email address the deployer invited.
setup.existingAccount: Already have an account? Sign in first
setup.consent: I am the intended recipient and accept responsibility as this business’s owner.
setup.invalidToken: This token is unknown, expired, already used, or intended for another email. Check the invited address or ask the deployer for a new token.
setup.conflict: The business may already be initialized, or this email already has an account. Sign in with the intended account and reopen this page to inspect your access.
setup.networkError: The result could not be read. Your inputs are still here. Sign in and reopen setup to check whether acceptance succeeded before trying again.
setup.recovery: Refreshing or leaving this page clears the token and draft. If a response was lost, sign in with the intended account and return here. An existing owner can open the business console; a new setup token is only needed if setup is still incomplete.
setup.created: {{name}} is initialized with invitation-only customer registration.
setup.alreadyStaff: Your signed-in account already has business access.
setup.completeHint: Continue in business context to configure supply, sale terms, collection and customers.
setup.firstKey: Show the one-time personal customer key
setup.firstKeyHint: This is a consumption key for your personal customer account, not a business administrator credential. You can manage or replace it later from that account.
setup.identityUnavailable: Your sign-in state could not be checked. Retry before submitting ownership acceptance.

checkoutChoices.label: Payment route
checkoutChoices.error: Payment routes could not be loaded.
checkoutChoices.empty: No payment route is currently available. Contact the business.
checkoutChoices.help: Test routes use sandbox money; live routes may charge real money. Availability is configuration status, not external payment certification.
checkoutChoices.stale: The available route has changed. Your previous choice is retained for an unchanged retry. To start a new payment, explicitly select a current route.
checkoutChoices.retryHelp: An unchanged retry recovers the original payment shown below (amount in fiat minor units). Refreshes do not replace it. Editing starts a new payment intent.

businessReadiness.title: Business setup
businessReadiness.intro: Prepare a solo pay-as-you-go business. These checks use your current business role and saved configuration.
businessReadiness.error: The current checks could not be read. No previous result is being treated as current; refresh or check your business access.
businessReadiness.ready: Configuration is ready for the first customer journey.
businessReadiness.restricted: Your current role cannot read this configuration check.
businessReadiness.askOwner: Ask the business owner or an authorized colleague to review this step.
businessReadiness.boundary: These are current configuration facts. They do not prove an upstream request, payment, callback or email delivery succeeded. Complete the first customer call and inspect its immediate bill proof; closed-period exports come later. Configuration can change after this snapshot.
businessReadiness.optional: Extra staff and sold plans are optional for this first pay-as-you-go journey. Invite-only admission supports direct invitation links without requiring SMTP.

profile.title: Business identity
profile.ready: The intended owner has initialized the business name.
profile.todo: Complete the owner setup and save the business identity.

supply.title: Configured model supply
supply.ready: At least one supported chat route has a current price and an available credential that this process can open. No upstream request was made.
supply.todo: Configure a supported chat model and price with an active credential. Disabled, cooling-down or unreadable credentials do not qualify.

saleTerms.title: Active customer sale terms
saleTerms.ready: A currently effective default sale book prices at least one configured chat model.
saleTerms.todo: Publish and activate a default sale book for a configured chat model. A draft, future schedule or unrelated model does not qualify.

collection.title: Selected collection path
collection.ready: An explicitly selected enabled merchant, readable credentials, compatible collection terms and public return URL are configured. This is not a payment certification.
collection.todo: Choose and enable a checkout merchant, configure compatible collection currency/conversion and the public return URL, and retain the encryption key. Stored merchants alone do not qualify.

admission.title: Customer admission
admission.ready: An invitation workflow or deliberately opened registration is available. No customer or email delivery is required for this check.
admission.todo: Restore an invitation or registration path under the intended owner.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.intro: Retain frozen period or statement evidence, its manifest and trust inputs, then verify the committed records locally or offline.
evidence.roleRequired: Customer owners and admins can mint and download organization evidence. Ask your account owner for an export.
evidence.retainTrust: Retain and inspect your ledger trust
evidence.selectionChanged: The returned evidence does not match the selected customer, period or manifest.
evidence.statementNotice: This action freezes an issued statement’s evidence once. Later requests return the same committed bundle; open statements cannot be exported.
evidence.mintNotice: Choose inclusive UTC dates, up to 366 fully ended days. This appends a ledger commitment. The same span always returns its original frozen bundle.
evidence.empty: No evidence bundles have been minted.
evidence.scopeNote: The scope above is part of the commitment. Verification checks committed artifacts and ledger inclusion; it does not recompute every settlement charge or prove honest upstream usage, complete supplier books or an independent witness. The selected manifest initially comes from this server. Save the inputs separately and compare the operator key independently.
evidence.notVerified: Not yet verified locally. Downloads preserve evidence even when verification fails.
evidence.verified_retainedKey: Committed artifacts and inclusion verified; the signed head matches the retained operator key and your customer ledger origin. Original key trust and verifier distribution still require an independent channel.
evidence.verified_suppliedKey: Committed artifacts, inclusion and signature verified using the bundle-supplied key. This does not independently authenticate that key.
evidence.verified_unsigned: Committed artifacts and inclusion verified. This bundle has no signed head; no operator signature or historical continuity is established.

refundCash.stateRetained: The original approval or note state is retained. This cash return cannot authorize another payout.

chargebackCorrection.retained: The correction cancels the false receipt and records the actual loss. The original credit benefit, resolution and debt documents are retained for finance review; this is not a second provider loss.

statementPayment.title: Statement repayment
statementPayment.help: Pays the selected bill’s outstanding debt. It does not add wallet credit or renew a plan.
statementPayment.none: No unreserved debt is available. Resume a pending payment above.
statementPayment.notPayable: This statement has no payable issued debt.
statementPayment.reviewRequired: This debt needs source or collection review. Contact the operator; the displayed balance remains outstanding.
statementPayment.partial: Partial amount in credits (leave blank for full available debt)
statementPayment.invalid: Enter a positive amount with at most six decimal places.
statementPayment.confirmHelp: The fiat price rounds up to the smallest currency unit. The exact selected debt stays fixed. Only a confirmed payment clears the bill.
statementPayment.retained: Retry keeps the original charge of {{amount}} fiat minor {{currency}}.
statementPayment.retryHelp: Retry unchanged or resume the existing payment above.
statementPayment.selectStatement: Choose a statement below to review and repay its exact outstanding debt.
statementPayment.paid: Payment applied to statement debt: {{amount}} credits.
statementPayment.payable: Payment received: {{amount}} credits retained for refund review. The original debt allocation could not be applied.
statementPayment.awaiting: No payment has been applied yet.

creditTerms.title: Monthly credit terms
creditTerms.description: This wallet credit facility is separate from the plan receivable limit. It permits approved borrowing; it is not a payment or a plan grant.
creditTerms.graceHint: Leave blank to disable automatic monthly dunning. Enter 0 for no extra grace.
creditTerms.invalid: Use an exact nonnegative amount with at most six decimal places, and whole days from 0 to 3650.
creditTerms.retained: The outcome is not confirmed. Your exact decision is retained for retry; fields stay locked until confirmation.
creditTerms.explain: Changes the total borrowing limit, future invoice payment terms and current monthly dunning grace. Existing invoices, plan terms and manual or archive restrictions remain. This does not collect money or immediately remove a suspension.
creditTerms.saved: Credit decision confirmed. Current terms are shown above.
creditTerms.uncertain: The server outcome could not be confirmed. Retry this same decision to recover its result.

monthlyStatements.title: Monthly wallet-credit statements
monthlyStatements.description: Monthly usage and borrowing statements, separate from sold-plan statements. Open a document to inspect its original itemization and issue terms.
monthlyStatements.recorded: Money reflects the recorded statement payment projection. An elapsed due date displays overdue; reading does not reconcile or change the ledger.
monthlyStatements.proofHint: These are the original stored anchor and window identifiers. Displaying them does not independently verify the document.
monthlyStatements.empty: No monthly statements on this page.
monthlyStatements.closedMonth: Choose a fully ended UTC month.
monthlyStatements.generateHint: Build the working copy from recorded usage. An already issued statement remains unchanged.
monthlyStatements.issueHint: Issue the reviewed usage and credit figures with these payment terms from today UTC. Repayments still follow the oldest credit draws first. Changed figures or terms require a fresh review.
monthlyStatements.retained: The outcome is not confirmed. Retry the same request before starting another action.
monthlyStatements.uncertain: The outcome could not be confirmed. Retry this exact request.
monthlyStatements.stale: This review is out of date. Generate or refresh the draft above, reopen its detail and review the current figures before issuing.
monthlyStatements.generatedSuccess: Monthly draft is ready for review.
monthlyStatements.emptyMonth: No recorded usage for that month; no statement was created.

monthlyPayment.title: Record a monthly repayment
monthlyPayment.hint: Record money already received and verified. Repayment covers the oldest credit debt through this month, including earlier unbilled usage.
monthlyPayment.amountHint: Enter the verified amount in credits, with up to six decimals. The server checks current debt before posting.
monthlyPayment.invalidAmount: Enter a positive exact amount with no more than six decimal places.
monthlyPayment.referenceHint: Use the original bank or payment reference. A reference can be recorded only once, including manual top-ups.
monthlyPayment.retained: The outcome is uncertain. Keep this form open and retry the same request; the amount, reference and reason are retained.
monthlyPayment.uncertain: The response was interrupted. Retry the same request to recover the original receipt.
monthlyPayment.confirmHint: Confirm that this payment was received and verified. It repays credit only; it does not initiate a payment or add wallet funds.
monthlyPayment.success: Monthly repayment recorded. Retain this original receipt.

sale.title: Customer sale books
sale.noBooks: No sale books yet. Create a book, save its model prices, publish, then activate a version.
sale.loadDirectoryError: Sale directory could not be loaded.
sale.roleRequired: Sale books require owner, admin or finance access.
sale.storedError: Stored amounts cannot be edited exactly
sale.exactApi: Use the exact-integer API; this editor will not round saved prices.
sale.readOnly: Your role can read sale terms and manage authorized customer assignments. Book editing requires catalog authority.
sale.previewHint: Use customer preview to inspect the selected condition and all charged dimensions.
sale.draftHint: Customer sale prices are credits. One credit is 1,000,000 minor units. Supplier cost is configured separately. Saving creates a new draft revision and changes no active customer price.
sale.exactEndRequired: An exact UTC end is required
sale.activationHint: Publishing alone never activates a price. Effective windows are UTC and exclude their end. Resolution uses a customer model override, then its assigned book, then the business default. Missing models fall through; an explicit zero price wins.
sale.startHint: Blank starts when the server commits; future dates end in Z.
sale.endHint: Blank stays effective until replaced or ended.
sale.replaceHint: Replacement ends the selected window atomically at the new start. Choose none only when there is no overlap.
sale.loadBeforeSave: Load the relevant customer and schedule history before saving.
sale.loadDefaultsError: Default history could not be loaded.
sale.loadCustomerHistoryError: Customer history could not be loaded.
sale.previewDescription: Preview rates declared usage without contacting a model or reserving funds. Effective terms are resolved for the selected customer and instant. A draft comparison does not activate that draft.
sale.atHint: Blank uses the server's current instant.
sale.rateHint: Six fractional digits; zero is an explicit free rate.
sale.optionalRateHint: Blank uses the documented base-rate fallback; per-request blank means no flat fee.
sale.conditionHint: Each match replaces the complete price set. Token bounds are inclusive; ambiguous overlaps are refused on save.
sale.savedDraft: Saved revision {{revision}}. Publish an exact revision and then schedule it to activate.
sale.reloadDescription: Load saved revision {{revision}} of {{book}}. Unsaved editor content will be replaced.
sale.removeDescription: Remove {{model}} from the editor. This takes effect only after saving, publishing and activating a new version.
sale.publishedMessage: Published immutable version {{version}} from draft {{revision}}. It is not active until scheduled or assigned.
sale.savedSchedule: Recorded schedule {{id}}. Preview a customer to see the effective result.
sale.newRevision: Revision {{revision}} is now available. Your edits are retained; stale saves conflict.
sale.versions: Published versions: {{versions}}. Existing versions remain immutable.
sale.endDescription: End {{kind}} {{id}}. New requests after the end resolve the remaining terms. Already admitted requests keep their original prices. Ending a future window at its start cancels it.
sale.storedRange: Stored amount exceeds this editor's exact range
sale.chatPositive: Chat maximum output must be positive
sale.nonChatZero: Non-chat maximum output must be zero
sale.inputOnlyZero: Input-only modes require zero output price
sale.conditionRequired: Each conditional rate needs a tier or token bound
sale.conditionLimit: At most 100 conditional rates are supported
sale.modelNames: Model names must be nonempty and unique, at most 200 characters
sale.utcFormat: Use a UTC timestamp such as 2026-12-01T00:00:00Z
sale.whole: {{label}} must be a whole number from 0 to {{maximum}}
sale.exactAmount: {{label}}: use an exact nonnegative amount with at most six fractional digits
sale.overlap: overlapping sale windows in the same scope
